title: Measuring Artifact Reliance in Machine-Generated Text Detectors
abstract: arXiv:2610.13583v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Detectors of machine-generated text score almost perfectly on scientific-literature benchmarks, implying we can reliably distinguish with these detectors human and machine-generated documents. We looked at ten scientific-document subsets from six popular resources, and on several of them that apparent ease is a side effect of how the documents were put together. A logistic regression using 27 superficial features reached 0.833-0.997 macro-F1, and on the three arXiv subsets it outperformed every detector we evaluate with F1-scores 0.951-0.997. The strongest cue to the detector is the PDF extraction artifact: human texts retain their original line breaks, whereas generated texts are extracted as a single block of prose. This cue, together with three other formatting features, tell the classes apart at 0.996 AUC. To distinguish benchmarks that contain such a signal from detectors that rely on one, we introduce format counterfactuals: just r

translated_title: 测量机器生成文本检测器对伪影的依赖
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.13583v1 公告类型： new 摘要：机器生成文本检测器在科学文献基准测试上的得分近乎完美，这意味着我们可以依靠这些检测器可靠地区分人类撰写与机器生成的文档。我们研究了来自六个常用资源的十个科学文档子集，发现在其中几个子集上，这种表面上的轻易表现其实是文档组装方式带来的副作用。一个仅使用27个表面特征的逻辑回归模型就达到了0.833-0.997的宏平均F1，而在三个arXiv子集上，它的表现超过了我们评估的所有检测器，F1分数为0.951-0.997。对分类最强的线索是PDF提取伪影：人类文本保留了原始的换行符，而生成文本则被提取为单一连续的文本块。这一线索与其他三个格式特征结合，能以0.996的AUC区分两类文本。为了区分包含此类信号的基准与依赖此类信号的检测器，我们提出了格式反事实方法：只需……
tldr: 该论文揭示机器生成文本检测器在科学文献基准上的近乎完美表现，很大程度上依赖于文档组装时引入的PDF提取伪影等表面格式特征（仅凭这些特征逻辑回归即可超过现有检测器），并提出“格式反事实”方法来区分包含此类信号的基准与依赖此类信号的检测器。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that the near-perfect performance of machine-generated text detectors on scientific benchmarks largely stems from superficial PDF extraction artifacts, and introduces format counterfactuals to distinguish benchmarks containing such signals from detectors that rely on them.
